name: Underlay path to the VPN peer dead: gateway's off-tunnel check + tunnel-down + independent probe loss -> underlay is the root, tunnel is the symptom (owner directive 2026-07-13, W2 drill shape)
comment: The W2 outer-path blackhole shape: the gateway's own off-tunnel reachability check to the peer's public address fails (ipsec_underlay_status, ACTIVE measurement riding the default route), the tunnel/IKE dies as a downstream symptom, and an independent customer-path probe sees the apps dark. The underlay template must win ownership (isp) and the IKE-flavored ipsec-tunnel-down must be contradicted by the underlay witness — a NOC chasing IKE config here would be chasing the wrong layer.
